title: Growth Essence Recipe
description: Makes the growth essences from Cobblemon Size Variations survival friendly/craftable.
body:
A data pack that makes it so that the various growth essences from [Cobblemon Size Variations](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-size-variations) can be crafted in survival mode.

As of now this data pack works with Minecraft 1.21 and 1.21.1. As the mod get's updated I will try and keep this updated as well.

_I am in no way affiliated with [Cudzer](https://modrinth.com/user/Cudzer) or the team behind [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon). I made this data pack because I enjoyed their mod, and wanted the option to change the Pokemon's sizes in survival on my server with my friends._
